items.en: «"Герани" меняются и противодействие не успевает» (Rybar: '"Gerans" are changing and countermeasures can't keep up')
items.nl: Rybar: '"Geranen" veranderen en de tegenmaatregelen kunnen het niet bijbenen'
items.sEn: The Russian milblogger channel Rybar argues that Russian drones are evolving faster than the means to counter them. It cites a statement by Zelensky's adviser "Flash" (Serhii Beskrestnov) on how jet-powered Gerans are constantly being modified and improved, and says that on this point he is hard to argue with. items.sEn: Rybar discusses the German company Helsing (maker of the HX-1 and HX-2 loitering munitions) moving into drone interceptors. items.en: Helsing unveils AD-2 'Ambush' counter-UAS interceptor missile (engagement altitude above 9 km) as part of its Contra air-defence suite, aimed at Russia's fast jet-powered Geran drones
items.nl: Helsing onthult AD-2 'Ambush'-onderscheppingsraket tegen drones (onderscheppingshoogte boven 9 km) als onderdeel van luchtverdedigingspakket Contra, gericht op Russische snelle Geran-jetdrones
items.sEn: German defence company Helsing presented its Contra air-defence offering on 26 October 2026: two new interceptor missiles plus AI software that automatically calculates the order and distance of intercepts. items.sEn: A Topwar analysis (by-line 'Glenn Witcher') sets the mid-October restriction on SpaceX's military Starshield package for Ukraine against the German HX-2 loitering munition, which can operate without a constant link to its operator. items.en: German investigators suspect GRU behind arson attack next to Rohde & Schwarz and Helsing in Munich
items.nl: Duitse onderzoekers vermoeden GRU achter brandaanslag naast Rohde & Schwarz en Helsing in München
